recentReviews.title: Poorly optimized software, uses way too many resources.
recentReviews.text: Leaving 1 star because I bought this camera mainly for the beauty mode feature and it's impossible to use properly. The software is terribly optimized; it puts way too much strain on the graphics card (and mine isn't even that old) if you try to use beauty mode and game at the same time. Whenever I activate the virtual camera for beauty mode, the PC freezes completely, even with lightweight games like Valorant. It's disappointing that they don't release updates to fix this. I ended up having to use it without the feature I actually bought it for. Do not recommend if you plan to game and stream at the same time.
recentReviews.summaryZh: 美颜虚拟摄像头与游戏同时使用时 GPU 负载高，电脑冻结；因此无法正常使用购买时看重的美颜功能。

recentReviews.title: ¡La actualización del sofware la ha dañado!
recentReviews.text: A quien se le ocurre tener en venta un producto el cual no es compatible con el sofware nuevo para su instalación? Me parece terrible, no pude sacarle provecho a su funcionalidad completa, se me ha dañado el sensor de movimiento.
recentReviews.summaryZh: 客户称新版软件安装后不兼容，无法使用完整功能，并称动作传感器损坏；因果关系尚未经验证。

recentReviews.title: Good luck if you need a warranty
recentReviews.text: The camera is excellent, and I hope yours does not encounter any issues. My camera was exceptional, and it featured AI gestures for my live stream. The software was somewhat unconventional, but it was understandable. The AI hand gestures connected to the algorithm if the appropriate background color was present or moved slightly to a different background. However, the issues you have encountered in negative reviews have arisen. It is nearly impossible to use the camera now. I cannot track without fear that it will always attempt to point to the sky. I am out of the return window with Amazon, so I contacted this company. They have requested numerous things, and if you take longer than a day, they constantly threaten to close the ticket. I do not stream full-time; I have a job and other commitments. I have met all their requests with constant blame directed at me, stating that I am responsible for the issues. How can I be responsible when the problem was not present before? I am still attempting to obtain a warranty repair. The camera is incredibly impressive! I hope you will be able to use yours without any issues. This company has proven to be a constant source of conflict in resolving my concerns.
recentReviews.summaryZh: 原先对画质和手势功能满意，后来跟踪会指向天花板；客户称过了亚马逊退货期后，保修沟通和处理困难。

lowStarReviews2026.title: Good camera, bad software, poor testing.
lowStarReviews2026.text:
UPDATE: The software developers just rolled out the fix for missing 4k resolution, but it looks pure cosmetic. The 4k now appears in the list of available resolutions, but even when it's selected the actual recording is still 1080. I'm returning the camera and looking for something more reliable.

The camera itself is ok, I like the quality and default picture settings; motion tracking is not perfect but acceptable. Taking two stars off because the software (OBSBOT Center) is overcomplicated and buggy. The worst thing is that it does not allow to select 4k resolution, the best option available is 1080@60fps. I tried a lot of things without any result. At the same time I was able to use the camera directly in other software like OBS Studio or Windows 11 Camera and 4k worked fine, so the problem is not in the camera or environment, but in the OBSBOT Center. The camera can be used without it, but some functions like virtual camera, overlays etc. will be unavailable or hard to configure. I've contacted customer support, still waiting for reply, but I suspect that my best option is to return the camera and get another brand with better software.
lowStarReviews2026.summaryZh: 客户称 OBSBOT Center 的 4K 选项及实际录制表现有问题，直接用 OBS Studio 或 Windows 相机时 4K 可用；同时认为软件设置复杂。

lowStarReviews2026.title: Overpriced webcam with harsh lighting that ruined my streaming setup
lowStarReviews2026.text: I bought this webcam for streaming and YouTube gaming, and it ended up being a big disappointment. The built‑in lighting is extremely bright, to the point where it lit up my whole room and made the video uncomfortable for both me and my audience. No matter how I adjusted it, the lighting was still harsh and distracting.For the price, I expected something much more usable. The quality didn’t match the cost, and the lighting alone made it impossible for me to stream the way I needed. I ended up returning it because it just wasn’t worth the money.
lowStarReviews2026.summaryZh: 直播场景中灯光过亮且难以调节，认为价格与体验不匹配，并称已退货。

lowStarReviews2026.title: Gimbal going nuts
lowStarReviews2026.text: I have had the camera for a little over a year -- used it lightly. Now the gimbal keeps banging around and the camera won't focus on me. I will rewrite this if I get customer service.
lowStarReviews2026.summaryZh: 轻度使用约一年后云台反复撞动，无法对准人脸。

lowStarReviews2026.title: Stopped working 2nd month
lowStarReviews2026.text: I really liked this camera at first. But it stopped working after a month or two- right in the middle of a business meeting. It just drooped down and will not rise itself back up. It is completely useless now and a waste of over $100. The support for this company is obnoxious and convoluted. You have to create some strange account that doesn’t get communication. Maybe their $500 dollars are better but I would not risk it.
lowStarReviews2026.summaryZh: 购买后约一两个月，云台在会议中下垂且无法抬起；客户同时抱怨售后流程。

lowStarReviews2026.title: Time to return it has passed unfortunately
lowStarReviews2026.text: I had a difficult time making this thing work for me.  I went back to my previous Logitech camera and microphone.  My previous camera was set up for facial recognition, the OBSBOT never worked for that. Unfortunately, the time to return it has passed.
lowStarReviews2026.summaryZh: 客户称面部识别功能不符合其需求，已重新使用原来的摄像头，且错过退货期。

lowStarReviews2026.title: Bulging camera and fire hazard
lowStarReviews2026.text: Honestly, there should be a recall on this camera. Zero stars if I could. My camera started to blow up and got overheated without me being around when I was on a meeting at night. It started bulging thank God I caught it before anything bad could happen. This is not good at all, especially if you have kids around very bad camera and it was my first time using it. Thank you Amazon for giving me a refund quickly as possible. This is not safe and is a fire hazard. I wasn’t able to return it at all could be considered a fire hazard.
lowStarReviews2026.summaryZh: 客户称首次会议使用时设备发热、机身鼓起，担忧安全风险；该情况为客户陈述，需核实。

lowStarReviews2026.title: Was great until it malfunctioned and support didn’t help
lowStarReviews2026.text: This is a great looking webcam, and for the time period that its functional will work great. But I had my camera for less than a year and a half before it started spinning back and forth out of control. I tried every troubleshooting step I could think of; reinstalling software, checking settings, updating firmware, switching computers, and the issue persisted. Contacted OBSbot support and they had me do the steps against and then sent me some firmware update over a Google Drive that stopped the spinning but also made the camera no longer function. Their solution at that point was to pay for a repair that costs as much as what I paid for the camera here, or a discount on a new purchase from their site that would still be more expensive than buying one here. Avoid the headache and get something else.
lowStarReviews2026.summaryZh: 使用不到一年半后云台失控旋转；客户称售后提供的固件使设备无法使用，并对维修方案不满。
